# Player Received Healing

Source: [wiki article 4813](../archive/4813.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4813-n1"></a>

- Received Healing includes self-healing; Event Player equals Healee, while Healer is source (equal for self-heal). Context includes Event Healing, health-pack flag, ability and incoming direction.
